utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Mr. Registrar, could you call the case, please.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Your Honours, case number IT-01-47-T, the Prosecutor versus Enver Hadzihasanovic and Amir Kubura.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you, Mr. Registrar. Could we have the appearances for the Prosecution.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: Good afternoon, Mr. President, Your Honours, Counsel, and everyone in and around the courtroom. For the Prosecution, Tecla Benjamin-Henry, Daryl Mundis, and the case manager, Mr. Andres Vatter.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you, Mr. Mundis. Could we have the appearances for Defence counsel.

utterances.speaker: MS. RESIDOVIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Good day, Mr. President. Good day, Your Honours. On behalf of General Enver Hadzihasanovic, Edina Residovic, counsel; Stephane Bourgon, co-counsel; and Muriel Cauvin, our legal assistant. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: MR. IBRISIMOVIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Good day, Your Honours. On behalf of Mr. Kubura, Rodney Dixon, Fahrudin Ibrisimovic, and Nermin Mulalic, our legal assistant.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you. The Trial Chamber would like to greet everyone present, the accused, members of the Prosecution, and Ms. Benjamin in particular who is back with us in the courtroom. Naturally, I would like to greet Defence counsel and Ms. Cauvin, whom we haven't seen for a while. We would also like to greet the accused and everyone else in the courtroom. As you know, we will be examining a witness today. But before we call the witness into the courtroom, I would like to inform the parties that the Prosecution on the 10th of June filed a request with the Trial Chamber in order to admit a written statement pursuant to Rule 98 bis. This concerns a number of issues in connection to potential witnesses who are now deceased. I would like the Defence to briefly comment on this request -- on this motion, so that we can rule on the motion as soon as possible. I should point out that as you are aware - the Trial Chamber has already indicated this - we hope that the Prosecution's case will be concluded by the end of June, and we hope that the Appeal Chamber will also have rendered its decision about a witness for whom protective measures have been requested. I'm now going to ask the registrar to go into private session. And could you check that there is no one in the gallery, unless we lower the blinds. I can't see anything from where I'm seated.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: to be reconvened on Tuesday, the 15th day of June, 2004, at 9.00 a.m.

procedural_notes.text: --- Whereupon the hearing adjourned at 7.06 p.m.,
